name: What Refinished Floors Add to a Sammamish Appraisal
title-tag: What Refinished Floors Add to a Sammamish, WA Appraisal
meta-description: Appraisers rate condition, not floors line by line. What a $4,788 refinish or a $2,388 recoat actually changes for a Sammamish seller — and when to skip it.
post-summary: April 7, 2027 · Appraisers rate a home’s overall condition against its comps; floors are an input, not a line item. What a full refinish and a one-day recoat really cost on 1,200 sq ft, why buyers price worn floors higher than the work does, and when a Sammamish seller should skip it.
